issues.problem: The dossier is written from the perspective of mid-2024 (e.g., "Status as of July 2024", postdoc contract ends Aug 2025, latest publications in 2024), but the call deadline is 15 September 2027. This creates a 3-year gap in the applicant's CV and publications right before the deadline, making it impossible to write a competitive proposal without inventing 3 years of recent history.
issues.fix: Shift all dates in the dossier (including birth year, degrees, employment, grants, publications, and ethics applications) forward by 3 years so the "present day" is mid-2027, aligning with the 2027 call deadline. Update dossier.yaml facts and publication keys accordingly.

issues.fix: Replace these with fictional institutions (e.g., "Bono East Health Research Institute", "Flanders Institute of Global Health", "University of Southern Ghana", "Kumasi University of Applied Sciences").
